from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Operating cash flow value from one company's financial report"""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code if available")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g. Q1 2024")
    operating_cash_flow_net: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities; signed value")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the cash flow value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
